cassia.predicted_cell_type: GABAergic cortical interneuron (inhibitory neuron), specifically a PVALB+ interneuron
strengths: Correctly identified GABAergic/MGE-derived interneuron identity via PVALB and LHX6.
Recognized chandelier-specific transcriptomic markers (CA8, ANO1, NPNT, CNTN5, THSD7A, ALK, TAFA4) and interpreted ECM/collagen genes as chandelier signature.
weaknesses: Mapped to the broader GABAergic interneuron class (CL:0011005) rather than the directly supported chandelier pvalb subtype.
Ranked PVALB+ basket cell as an alternative, although the chandelier markers favor the chandelier branch.

strengths: Core GABAergic identity is supported by observed PVALB/LHX6 expression.
Subrank candidates included more specific pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron and chandelier pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron.
weaknesses: Top1 is an overly broad ancestor and does not reflect the PVALB/chandelier specificity supported by the marker list.
No method-specific reasoning was provided to prioritize subtype markers over the general GABAergic label.
Reviewer returned __unavailable__; no cell-type hypothesis or enrichment-derived label was provided.

supporting: PVALB and LHX6 are observed DEGs establishing a GABAergic / MGE-derived interneuron lineage.
CA8, ANO1, NPNT, CNTN5, THSD7A, ALK and TAFA4 are observed DEGs supporting refinement to chandelier pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron (CL:4023036).
No out-of-scope contamination channel was identified; ECM/collagen genes (COL15A1, ADAMTS5, SMOC2) are consistent with the chandelier transcriptomic signature.
conflicting: In-house top1 GABAergic neuron is not conflicting but is too unspecific.
CASSIA rank2 lists PVALB+ basket cell as an alternative; however CA8/ANO1/NPNT favor the chandelier branch.
enrichment_or_literature: Literature-supported chandelier-cell markers (CA8, ANO1, NPNT, CNTN5, THSD7A, ALK, TAFA4) support the subtype refinement (PMIDs 32411596, 37745522, 39444736, 40268967, 31083689).
